subject.title: Feature: Agent 动态切换命令（不重启 Gateway）

question: Should OpenClaw support a channel/session-scoped `/agent <name>` switch for configured agents, and what authorization policy should decide which agents a channel sender can list and select?
rationale: The requested behavior crosses channel command handling, route resolution, session state, workspace isolation, tool authorization, and credential boundaries, so automation should not choose the permanent product/security contract.

options.title: Design guarded session switch
options.body: Add a core-supported session override that lists and switches only authorized configured agents, persists canonical state, and enforces existing subagent, sandbox, and tool policy.

options.title: Keep bindings static
options.body: Decline runtime channel switching and keep configured bindings plus Gateway restart or approved reload as the only supported cross-agent routing model.

options.title: Expose plugin seam first
options.body: Design a generic command or agent-picker SDK seam so channel plugins can implement visible switching after the core policy contract exists.

recommendation.title: Design guarded session switch
recommendation.body: Add a core-supported session override that lists and switches only authorized configured agents, persists canonical state, and enforces existing subagent, sandbox, and tool policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest feature-history signal across the multi-agent routing contract that this issue would extend.
